Package neqsim.process.operations.replay

Class ReplayTimeSeries

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.operations.replay.ReplayTimeSeries
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ReplayTimeSeries extends Object implements Serializable
Column-oriented time series consumed by ProcessReplay.

Time stamps are plain doubles in a unit of the caller's choice (for example seconds since the start of the window or epoch seconds). Each column holds one value per time stamp; missing values are NaN.

Version:
1.0
Author:
ESOL
